output.body: Isomorph: sum_to(n) equals 1+2+...+n, with base case sum_to(0)=0 to stop the calls, and for n above 0 the step is sum_to(n) = n + sum_to(n-1), which moves the input toward the base. So sum_to(3) = 3 + sum_to(2) forces sum_to(2) next, which forces sum_to(1), and sum_to(0)=0 ends the chain. Your own problem needs the same two parts: a base case and a step that calls the function on a smaller input.
